Microsoft Infrastructure Engineer 
 Req number: 
R8753 
 Employment type: 
Full time 
 Worksite flexibility: 
Hybrid 
 Who we are 
 CAI is a global services firm with over 9,000 associates worldwide and a yearly revenue of $1.3 billion+. We have over 40 years of excellence in uniting talent and technology to power the possible for our clients, colleagues, and communities. As a privately held company, we have the freedom and focus to do what is right—whatever it takes. Our tailor-made solutions create lasting results across the public and commercial sectors, and we are trailblazers in bringing neurodiversity to the enterprise.
 
 Job Summary 
We are looking for a motivated Microsoft Infrastructure Engineer ready to take us to the next level! If you have experience with Microsoft RDS, Entra ID, and are looking for your next career move, apply now. 
 Job Description 
 We are looking for a Microsoft Infrastructure Engineer to design, implement, and support enterprise Microsoft infrastructure and secure remote access solutions. This position will be a contract and hybrid in Newark, DE. 
 What You’ll Do 
 Design and implement enterprise Microsoft infrastructure solutions
 Deploy and support Microsoft Remote Desktop Services (RDS) environments
 Design and deploy Remote Desktop Gateway solutions and secure vendor access
 Implement Microsoft Global Secure Access, Zscaler, or other Zero Trust remote access solutions
 Implement Zero Trust security architectures
 Support Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access environments
 Work with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Server 2019/2022
 Support virtualization platforms, including VMware vSphere and Hyper-V
 Work with firewalls, routing, VPN technologies, and secure remote access platforms
 Troubleshoot infrastructure issues and maintain technical documentation
 Support infrastructure project delivery and migration initiatives
 What You’ll Need 
 Required:
 5+ years of experience implementing enterprise Microsoft infrastructure solutions
 Hands-on experience deploying Microsoft Remote Desktop Services (RDS) environments
 Experience designing and deploying Remote Desktop Gateway and secure vendor access solutions
 Hands-on experience deploying Microsoft Global Secure Access, Zscaler, or other Zero Trust remote access solutions
 Strong knowledge of Microsoft Entra ID and Conditional Access
 Experience implementing Zero Trust security architectures
 Strong understanding of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and Windows Server 2019/2022
 Experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware vSphere or Hyper-V
 Experience with firewalls, routing, VPN technologies, and secure remote access platforms
 Strong troubleshooting, documentation, and project delivery skills
 Preferred:
 Experience deploying Global Secure Access within Microsoft 365 E5 environments
 Experience supporting utility, critical infrastructure, or regulated environments
 Experience with Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and Defender for Identity
 Familiarity with the Cybersecurity Framework and/or CISA guidance
 Experience migrating organizations from traditional VPN architectures to Zero Trust access models
 Physical Demands 
 Ability to safely and successfully perform the essential job functions consistent with the ADA and other federal, state, and local standards
 Sedentary work that involves sitting or remaining stationary most of the time, with occasional need to move around the office to attend meetings, etc.
 Ability to conduct repetitive tasks on a computer, utilizing a mouse, keyboard, and monitor
  
 
 Reasonable accommodation statement 
 If you require a reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employment selection process, please direct your inquiries to application.accommodations@cai.io or (888) 824 – 8111.
